paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.24% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+0.49%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.90%). Brent crude changed -1.48% to 104.49. Gold changed +1.63% to 4,175.0. Bitcoin changed -0.76% to 80,942.7188. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.19%, a relative move of -0.52%. Among the firms tracked, Lazard (-5.09%) and Bank of America (-4.76%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: BlackRock pulls in $205bn to take assets to record high (FT Markets). World’s largest asset manager has become an increasingly powerful force in private capital after acquisitions of HPS and Global Infrastructure Partners Deals and capital markets: India approves biggest foreign takeover of domestic bank (FT World). Canada’s Fairfax Financial Holdings to buy nearly 61% of IDBI Bank for $5.6bn Central banks and macro: US inflation jumps to 3.7% as Iran war drives up prices (FT World). Rebound in fuel costs has piled pressure on voters ahead of midterm elections Central banks and macro: US inflation again set to be a crucial factor for the midterms (FT World). Donald Trump was re-elected on the back of inflation anger, and his party is now in danger of losing control of the House and Senate for the same reason Geopolitics and trade: The $32bn tussle over oil industry’s Iran war windfall (FT Markets). Investors are keen to see how world’s largest crude companies plan to deploy extra cash generated by soaring energy prices
